subject: Intro + exec slot coordination — NovaBio VP attendance
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@novabio.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lily Nguyen <lily@novabio.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request for VP slot (NovaBio demo)

Hi Chloe / Marcus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team found the platform compelling. Our CIO (Anita Rao) has asked to join a short executive-level demo before the end of next week to validate the security and latency claims for a pilot.

High level ask: can we lock a 45-minute slot (30-min demo + 15-min exec Q&A) with a VP/CIO-level attendee from Redwood? Ideally Anita wants something in the US-PDT morning window (Jun 20–22).

Attendees on our side: Anita Rao (CIO), Lily Nguyen (Director, Engineering) and a solutions architect (TBD).

Would appreciate:
- two possible 45-min windows you can reserve
- a brief 1-pager or agenda to share internally (security + data residency bits called out)

Thanks — Samir

Attachments: none
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@novabio.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request for VP slot (NovaBio demo)

Hi Samir — great to hear Anita can join. Happy to coordinate.

Available windows (PDT):
- Wed Jun 21, 09:30–10:15 (45m)
- Thu Jun 22, 10:00–10:45 (45m)

We’ll plan: 30m demo focused on data isolation/SOC2/latency at your scale, then 15m for exec questions. I’m including a draft agenda (attached) that calls out the security slides first so Anita can see those early.

Quick Qs:
- Do you want the demo to include a live query against a sanitized dataset? (we can do a short live run but can also show replayed logs if preferred)
- Will any non-public docs be shared so we can prepare a short NDA-friendly appendix?

I’ve attached: nova_demo_agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + slide list). Marcus — looped you in for VP coverage — can you confirm availability or a delegate if Anita wants a CXO-level conversation?

Thanks,
Chloe

--
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: nova_demo_agenda_v1.pdf (agenda, 2 pages)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@novabio.com>, chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request for VP slot (NovaBio demo)

Samir / Chloe — I can join as the exec sponsor on short notice for either Wed 09:30 or Thu 10:00. If Anita prefers a more senior product/tech conversation, I’ll join and hand off to our Head of Research where needed.

One ask from my side: please confirm the primary technical concern(s) Anita wants us to address (security posture, encryption, audit logs, or latency at 1M tokens/min). We’ll tailor the first 10 minutes to that.

Also attaching a short exec brief that outlines our SOC2 artifact inventory and typical timeline for evidence requests — should help prep Anita’s team.

—Marcus

Attachments: redwood-exec-brief.pdf (summary, 3 pages)
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@novabio.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lily Nguyen <lily@novabio.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request for VP slot (NovaBio demo)

Thanks — quick update from Anita: she has a last-minute board prep that conflicts with the Wed morning slot and asked if we can move to Thu Jun 22. Preferably Thu 10:00–10:45 PDT.

If that works for Redwood, we’ll lock it. Also: primary concerns are data residency and audit logs; latency at pilot scale is secondary. We’ll plan for a short live replay of sanitized queries.

Apologies for the flip — appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Samir
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@novabio.com>
Cc: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request for VP slot (NovaBio demo)

Hi Samir — Thu Jun 22, 10:00–10:45 PDT is confirmed on our side.

Plan for the session:
- 10:00–10:10 — Quick intros and agenda (Chloe + Samir)
- 10:10–10:25 — Security & compliance (Marcus) — SOC2 artifacts, data residency, audit log capabilities
- 10:25–10:35 — Live replay: sanitized queries and latency snapshot (Engineering lead)
- 10:35–10:45 — Exec Q&A / next steps (Marcus + Chloe)

I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and the final slides (redwood-exec-brief.pdf) attached. If you prefer a separate non-recorded appendix for any confidential artifacts, flag that and we’ll route through secure share.

See you Thu — thanks for coordinating.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
